audit.rule: A sample may preserve hue relationship only when its coordinate is visibly inside an iron face. Brown oxidation is overlay evidence. Cast shadow, edge shadow, thin scroll ambiguity, and wood ambiguity are excluded. No photographed RGB value is copied into PBR base colour because the image contains illumination and reflection.

samples.label: upper_scale_dark
samples.audit_reason: The coordinate sits beside the upper collar where the vertical iron throws a dark edge shadow across the strap.

samples.label: upper_scale_violet
samples.audit_reason: The coordinate is inside the broad upper strap face and clear of the scroll openings and collar shadow.

samples.label: upper_scale_warm
samples.audit_reason: The coordinate is centered on the upper strap face between fasteners.
